lightcone.lc_두더지파가_환영해.name: The Moles Welcome You
lightcone.lc_두더지파가_환영해.skill.name: Fantastic Adventure
lightcone.lc_두더지파가_환영해.skill.desc: When the wearer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate to attack enemies, they gain 1 stack of Mischievous. Each stack increases the wearer's ATK by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%.
lightcone.lc_두더지파가_환영해.story: The Moles, The Moles, we're on our way now! Clever Moles fear nothing! The Moles, The Moles, adventure starts now!
lightcone.lc_인사록·음률_사냥.name: Ninja Record: Sound Hunt
lightcone.lc_인사록·음률_사냥.skill.name: Showtime!
lightcone.lc_인사록·음률_사냥.skill.desc: Increases the wearer's Max HP by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%. When the wearer loses or restores HP, increases their CRIT DMG by 18%/22.5%/27%/31.5%/36% for 2 turn(s). This effect can only be triggered once per turn.
lightcone.lc_인사록·음률_사냥.story: Ninja arts are ever-changing, sound and hunting magnificent. Listen——
lightcone.lc_멍!_산책_시간!.name: Woof! Walk Time!
lightcone.lc_멍!_산책_시간!.skill.name: Run!
lightcone.lc_멍!_산책_시간!.skill.desc: Increases the wearer's ATK by 10%/12%/15%/17%/20%, and increases their DMG to enemies afflicted with Burn or Bleed by 16%/20%/24%/28%/32%. This also applies to DoT.
lightcone.lc_멍!_산책_시간!.story: What a pity that no one has noticed yet...
lightcone.lc_전멸.name: Mutual Demise
lightcone.lc_전멸.skill.name: Legion
lightcone.lc_전멸.skill.desc: If the wearer's current HP is less than 80%, CRIT Rate increases by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%.
lightcone.lc_전멸.story: A faint power drawn from time. Small, fleeting moments weave together a magnificent destiny.
lightcone.lc_무너진_행복.name: Shattered Home

lightcone.lc_무너진_행복.skill.desc: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer to enemies above 50% Max HP by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%.
lightcone.lc_무너진_행복.story: A faint power drawn from time. Small, fleeting moments weave together a magnificent destiny.

lightcone.lc_천경.story: A faint power drawn from time. Small, fleeting moments weave together a magnificent destiny.
